built.provenance_chain_checker: packages/swing-lab/src/provenanceChain.ts (provenance-chain-1) — deep-walk checker verifying every user-visible Result-contract claim traces to OBSERVED/TRACKED/PREDICTED provenance, and that no PREDICTED value surfaces as an observation anywhere in the chain. Rules read from existing contracts (offlineStroke.ts ContactEstimate, report.ts PaddleReportEntry/BallStageReportEntry, paddleCropRecovery.ts tracked_estimate bridge, strokeHeuristic.ts StrokePrediction, strokeResultModel.ts MeasuredRowView provenance chips), never invented.
rules: chain_contact_estimate_without_evidence — a full ContactEstimate (status=estimated) must carry >=1 traceable supporting evidence signal (registered family, finite timestampMs, weight>0)
chain_confirmation_without_signal — ballConfirmed/paddleConfirmed=true require a signal of the matching modality in supportingEvidence
chain_unregistered_evidence_signal — evidence signal outside the registered observed/tracked families
chain_abstention_with_estimate — an abstained contact must not carry estimatedContactMs
chain_tracked_without_observations — status=tracked stage claims require observationCount >= 1
chain_bridge_without_anchors — PREDICTED bridge points (bridgePointCount) require >=2 real observations to interpolate between; count must be a non-negative finite number

chain_predicted_as_observation — a source=tracked_estimate observation must not carry a positive detectorScore or nearWrist=true (bridge points are PREDICTED, detectorScore is 0 and nearWrist false by construction)
chain_prediction_without_evidence — a stroke prediction committing to a label must carry its evidence trail (null/UNKNOWN abstentions exempt)
chain_unknown_row_provenance — Result-surface measured rows must carry a registered chip (DETECTED/ESTIMATE/MEASURED/PREDICTED)
chain_predicted_row_masquerade — predicted_stroke rows must be PREDICTED and contact_estimate rows must be ESTIMATE; a prediction/estimate never surfaces under an observation chip

design_decision_digest_echoes.decision: Evidence tracing applies only to FULL ContactEstimate nodes (which always carry supportingEvidence/limitingFactors when estimated). Experiment digests that echo an estimate (status + estimatedContactMs + errMs-vs-gold only) are derived reporting whose provenance lives in the run artifact they summarize; they are not chain sources.
reviewed_digest_nodes: datasets/experiments/wave-a/H-downstream.json ($.<case>.baseline/candidate.contact — ballConfirmed/paddleConfirmed echoes without supportingEvidence: summary of runs, not runtime artifacts)
design_decision_digest_echoes.note: These 3 files (16 digest nodes) were inspected by hand before the recognizer was narrowed; nothing in them conflates PREDICTED with observed. Recorded here so the exemption is auditable, not silent.
